# Third-party files in this folder

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `d3.min.js` | [D3](https://d3js.org) | 7.9.0 | ISC |
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | [xterm.js](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js) | 5.x | MIT |
| `addon-fit.js` | [@xterm/addon-fit](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/master/addons/addon-fit) | 0.x | MIT |
| `qrcode.js` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) by Kazuhiko Arase | 1.x | MIT |

They are shipped unmodified, apart from whitespace around three minus signs in `d3.min.js`, so the hub runs with no
npm install and no build step. Their licenses apply to these files.
